Taiwan lost its UN membership in 1971 after the UN passed a resolution transferring the UN membership to the People’s Republic of China (P.R.C.). Taiwan is not a signatory to the 1951 Refugee Convention and lacks domestic law protecting asylum seekers and refugees. Asylum seekers are treated under the National Immigration Act and the National Immigration Agency (NIA) is responsible for all immigration-related policies and procedures for foreign workers, immigrant services, and repatriation of undocumented immigrants.
